values.note: 100 wooded, shaded campsites for tents and small RVs up to 25 ft; A-section sites are flexible group sites (up to 18 people). Each site: picnic table, grill, fire ring, parking for two vehicles; family sites limited to 6 people and 2 tents.

sites.source: https://www.fairfaxcounty.gov/parks/burke-lake/campgrounds ('100 wooded campsites suitable for tents and small RVs, up to 25 feet') + FAQ, read 2026-10-21

values.note: Bathhouse with hot showers and flush toilets; water spigots; dump station included for campers ($28 for non-campers); camp store with ice, firewood, charcoal and light supplies (seasonal hours); Wi-Fi only at the camp office; playground.

facilities.source: https://www.fairfaxcounty.gov/parks/burke-lake/campgrounds ('Fresh water spigots and a dump station (included with registration or $28 for non-campers)', 'Bathhouse with restrooms, sinks, showers and flushing toilets', 'Campstore offers ice, firewood and charcoal', 'Wi-Fi access at the camp office'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: All sites reservable in advance online (Fairfax County Park Authority's US eDirect site) or at the park office, and family sites can also be taken walk-up on the day of arrival. Max 14 consecutive nights, then 4 nights off-site between visits. Cancellation fees from $25; wilderness (primitive group) camping by phone only, 703-323-6600.

booking.source: https://www.fairfaxcounty.gov/parks/burke-lake/campgrounds ('Family camping reservations can be made online or in-person (walk-up) on the day of arrival'; 'A maximum of 14 consecutive nights is permitted. Added no hookups, 100 sites for RVs to 25 ft, showers/flush toilets/water/dump/camp store/Wi-Fi at the office, booking on Fairfax's US eDirect site with day-of walk-ups and a 14-night limit.
